description: Unit test class for the EmailMan module in SuiteCRM, utilizing PHPUnit framework. Contains test methods for various functionalities such as object creation, query generation, email sending, validation, and deletion in the EmailMan context.

classes.name: EmailManTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for the EmailMan module, validating behavior and functionality of email management features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets global user, loads language strings.

methods.name: testtoString
methods.description: Verifies the toString() output with default and set attribute values.

methods.name: testEmailMan
methods.description: Tests constructor initialization and basic properties of EmailMan bean.

methods.name: testcreate_new_list_query
methods.description: Checks SQL query generation for new list with various parameter configurations.

methods.name: testcreate_queue_items_query
methods.description: Tests SQL query generation for email queue items with and without parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_list_query
methods.description: Verifies list query creation with empty and specific filters.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks the correctness of list view data returned by get_list_view_data()

methods.name: testset_as_sent
methods.description: Validates behavior of set_as_sent() method with different delete flag parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_indiv_email
methods.description: Tests creation of individual email and checks for valid ID length.

methods.name: testverify_campaign
methods.description: Verifies campaign validation logic returns false for empty input.

methods.name: testsendEmail
methods.description: Tests email sending functionality with related type set or unset.

methods.name: testvalid_email_address
methods.description: Checks email address validation with empty, invalid, and valid addresses.

methods.name: testis_primary_email_address
methods.description: Verifies behavior of primary email check without email addresses.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Tests export SQL query creation with empty and specific filters.

methods.name: testcreate_ref_email
methods.description: Tests creation of reference email and cleanup deletion, verifying email ID length.
